parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal law and legal same-sex acts are major positives, but risk turns on what follows outing: recent reports document discrimination and frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people in public and government settings, anti-LGBT rallies, a newly elected leader’s derogatory video, and death threats from supporters. Gender-identity recognition rulings, third-gender categories, pride events and curricula are climate signals, not visitor-facing protections; care is limited and document verification remains intrusive. With thin evidence of border/custody targeting, those are open questions rather than known exposure, but overall an outed visitor faces elevated harassment, institutional bias and possible violence without reliable recourse.
